claim: Use one 256-thread block per row with coalesced two-pass processing, warp-shuffle sum-of-squares reduction, and a small shared-memory warp-sum reduction.
expected_effect: On sm_70 this removes global/intermediate reduction traffic, keeps both reads and writes coalesced, uses fast warp intrinsics for the reduction, and provides enough parallelism for all tested batch sizes while avoiding extra synchronization or bank-conflict-prone shared layouts.
